property_summary: For any caller that is the current owner, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) completes (does not revert) and updates c.owner() to newOwner; the mutant that injects an unconditional revert in the onlyOwner modifier can cause the call to revert and thus not update owner for some inputs.
change_summary: Insert a revert after the require so the modifier always reverts, preventing transferOwnership from ever completing.
